title: Pokemon TCG Houndstone Trick Or Trade 106/198 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare Pokémon card features the powerful Psychic type Houndstone, from the 2023 Trick Or Trade set. With a stunning Holo Rare finish, this Stage 1 card has 140 HP and is perfect for any Pokémon TCG collector or player. The card is standard sized and made from high-quality paper material, illustrated by Kouki Saitou.

The Houndstone card is uncategorized, unsigned, and has no vintage value. It is suitable for ages 6 and up, and is a must-have addition to any Pokémon card collection. Don't miss your chance to own this rare and valuable card, numbered 106/198 in the set.
